description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the JsonDownloadFormat class in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up a test environment, loads test data, and verifies the behavior of the getDownloadFileName method.

classes.name: DownloadFormatTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing download format functionality in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, instantiates the download format object, and loads test data.

methods.name: testDownloadFileName
methods.description: Verifies that the generated download file names match expected values for given input IDs.
